# shadox typography

Downloaded 2026-09-17 from the Google Fonts repository. Fonts are self-hosted; rendering does not contact a font CDN. Original font binaries are unmodified. CSS aliases do not alter font metadata.

| Font | UI usage | Source / license |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Space Grotesk (variable, 300–700) | Navigation wordmark, member header, default cover titles | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/spacegrotesk — Space-Grotesk-OFL.txt |
| Cormorant Garamond Italic (variable, 300–700) | Login brand heading, directory display wordmark, editorial covers | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/cormorantgaramond — Cormorant-Garamond-OFL.txt |

Both are licensed under SIL Open Font License 1.1. Commercial use and embedding/bundling are permitted subject to its conditions. Keep copyright and license files with redistribution. Do not sell the font files by themselves. Chinese body text retains the existing system font fallback; these display fonts are used for Latin lettering.
